IntegrationModes.description: Configured provider modes so the UI can label Demo / Not connected features truthfully.
IntegrationModes.title: IntegrationModes

OrderValueRecommendationRead.description: The commercial engine's order-value recommendation for a list price (advisory; not a product MOQ).
OrderValueRecommendationRead.title: OrderValueRecommendationRead

PartyUpdate.description:
Dirty fields plus ``expected_version``. Child lists, when sent, replace the current set: items with an
``id`` update that row, items without one are added, and rows left out are archived.
PartyUpdate.title: PartyUpdate

PermissionOverridePut.description: ``PUT .../permission-overrides/{key}``: a grant needs a scope, a revoke has none; a reason is required.
PermissionOverridePut.title: PermissionOverridePut

PermissionOverrideView.description: One open per-user override (grant or revoke; revoke always wins over roles and grants).
PermissionOverrideView.title: PermissionOverrideView

PreferencesPatch.description:
Dirty sections plus ``expected_version`` (api-conventions §6): the version the client read (0 before the
first save). A mismatch is 409 ``version_conflict`` carrying the current preferences.
PreferencesPatch.title: PreferencesPatch

PriceResolution.description:
The result of ``resolve_price``. ``found`` carries provenance (tier, list code, item id); ``ambiguous``
lists the candidates and never falls through to a less specific tier; a price is only ever returned in the
currency of the list it came from, so a currency label is never relabelled.
PriceResolution.title: PriceResolution

ProductPriceColumn.description:
The standard-tier price of a product in one currency, from a real active list (never relabelled or
converted): ``found``, ``ambiguous`` (several lists without a unique explicit priority; never guessed),
``unavailable`` (zero price) or ``not_found``.
ProductPriceColumn.title: ProductPriceColumn

ProductPrices.description:
Active prices of a product on a date across the price lists the actor may see, plus the product cost of
record for actors holding ``pricing.cost.read`` (absent and listed in ``redacted_fields`` otherwise).
ProductPrices.title: ProductPrices

QuoteCommercialRulesV1.description: ``quote_commercial`` v1 parameters. Thresholds exist only for explicitly configured currencies.
QuoteCommercialRulesV1.title: QuoteCommercialRulesV1

ReminderList.description: Offset page of the caller's reminders (api-conventions §9: ``Page{items, total, limit, offset}``).
ReminderList.title: ReminderList

SessionInfo.description: Returned by sign-in; the session token itself travels only in the HttpOnly cookie.
SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo

TaskTransition.description: ``expected_version`` is the task version the client acted on (api-conventions §6: 409 on mismatch).
TaskTransition.title: TaskTransition

get.summary: Audit entries, newest first, with keyset pagination (pass next_cursor back as cursor)

get.description:
Source-linked "what changed": ``since`` is last_ack, yesterday, last_workday or an ISO instant
(clamped to the seven-day change window); keyset pages of change rows.

Today's briefing. ``version`` keeps the list the client is showing (no re-sorting); the response
reports ``updates_available`` so the client can offer "N updates".

Products with every filter applied before pagination; ``total`` counts the same filtered set. Rows carry the
standard-list price in ``price_currency`` and the order-value recommendation only for ``pricing.price.read``.

Revoke the current session and clear the cookies. A signed-out, expired or revoked session still gets its
cookies cleared (with the 401), so a stale cookie never traps the browser.
